name: ERP
desc: Build an ERP platform — core financials, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and inventory on one ledger.
features:
## Core
- General ledger with a multi-dimensional chart of accounts
- Accounts payable — vendor bills, three-way match, approval workflows
- Accounts receivable — customer invoicing, collections, cash application
- Cash & bank management — statement reconciliation, positive pay
- Fixed assets — acquisition, depreciation schedules, disposal
- Tax engine — VAT/GST/sales-tax calculation & filing
- Multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation with intercompany eliminations
- Procure-to-pay — requisitions, purchase orders, vendor portals, OCR invoice capture
- Order-to-cash — sales orders, fulfillment, returns/RMA
- Multi-location inventory — lot/serial/bin tracking, multiple valuation methods
- Demand planning & reorder points
- Financial reporting & dashboards
- Role-based security & immutable audit trail

## Differentiators
- Manufacturing — multi-level BOMs, routings, work orders, MRP/MPS
- Warehouse management (WMS) — barcode picking, putaway/slotting, cycle counting
- Compliance automation — revenue recognition (ASC 606) & lease accounting (ASC 842)
- Embedded analytics & AI demand forecasting
